messages.subject: For Leandro García | Government relations, social performance and Peru mining execution
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Valencia,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Leandro García, Chief Executive Officer.

Buenaventura's operating footprint in Peru places government relations, community confidence, social performance and disciplined stakeholder execution at the center of long-term mining value. Those priorities align strongly with the work I lead today inside a major multinational mining operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement, coordinate complex regulatory and community matters across corporate and technical teams, and translate external commitments into accountable owners, evidence, timelines and escalation. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would value a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, social performance, ESG and mining execution might support Buenaventura's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Buenaventura.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
